data.display_address: The Sanctuary by Ellington, District 11, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience refined luxury living at The Sanctuary by Ellington, home to the prestigious Lakeview Villas, now available at a rare and unmatched super deal. This exceptional 5-bedroom villa is crafted with Ellington’s signature attention to detail, combining modern architecture, generous living spaces, and a tranquil lakeside ambiance that enhances everyday living.

Designed for families who value privacy, comfort, and quality, the villa features an elegant layout with floor-to-ceiling windows that fill each room with natural light. The calm surroundings, premium materials, and thoughtful spatial planning make this property one of the most desirable homes within the community.

Property Highlights:

5 Bedroom Standalone Villa – Spacious and thoughtfully designed for family living
BUA: 9,985 sqft – Expansive interiors with modern finishes and elegant layouts
Plot Size: 7234.42 sqft – Large Corner Plot, providing ample outdoor space and privacy
Backing a Green Belt – Enjoy serene views, natural surroundings, and a peaceful environment
Best Cluster – Located in one of the most desirable and well-planned clusters in the community
Lakeview Setting – Breathtaking water views and a tranquil lakeside lifestyle
Best Priced Villa of this Type – Exceptional value for this premium design
Price: 24,950,000 AED

This villa is perfect for families seeking a blend of modern luxury and natural beauty within a secure and master-planned environment. With its exceptional design, large layout, and peaceful lakefront positioning, it stands out as both a lifestyle upgrade and a strong long-term investment opportunity.
